title: Background Grid WebGL
concept: Holdfast, a chain of six late-night bouldering halls drilled on one 200 mm bolt pattern, set over a Three.js perspective floor grid that drifts toward the horizon with chalk-dust particles, a single orange circuit lane and damped mouse parallax.
notes: Grid is a custom shader plane (fwidth anti-aliased lines, distance fade, seamless drift cycle); dust is an additive Points layer. Reduced motion renders one still frame; no-WebGL falls back to a CSS line veil. Parallax is mouse-only, render loop pauses when the tab is hidden.
